input_population: P2 ACCEPT and WARN fixed-posture records; P2 EXCLUDED records remain excluded
unit_of_analysis: P2 representative frame from one source JSON record
selection_reason: Largest-component produced 5100/5100 usable eligible records, one connected component by construction, the smallest median bbox area, and no empty-mask WARN. It is frozen as a stable main-body geometry input, not as anatomical truth.
known_limitations: May discard real but disconnected limb-contact islands.
Has no independent anatomical or calibrated physical-contact ground truth.
Must not be interpreted as Head/Torso/Arm/Leg segmentation.
The freeze applies to PoPu research feature engineering only and may be reopened with independently paired truth or proprietary hardware data.
